messages:
Priya (Partnerships): FYI - LatticeGrid uploaded co-marketing assets and a draft case blurb for the cloud marketplace listing: https://drive.redwood/latticegrid. We need: logo lockup QA, marketplace tile (desktop + mobile sizes), hardware partner badge rules (they referenced NVIDIA Prime), and approval on the short case quote. Can we triage today? @Tom @Evan @Nora
Tom (Design): On it. Quick note: LatticeGrid's brand guide wants the partner logo centered with 32px clearspace. They also supplied a 16:9 hero and a square thumbnail. Will validate sizes and produce white-bg + dark-bg variants.
Evan (Growth): Good. For the marketplace listing we need a 1200x1200 square + 1600x600 hero for the marketplace header. Also short description (<=140 chars), one-line quote, and a feature tag list (e.g., "dedicated-capacity, on-prem, low-latency"). I've asked them for the final feature tags.
Nora - Legal: Heads-up: any mention of NVIDIA badge requires a partner badge usage agreement. Do they have a co-marketing badge approval from NVIDIA? If not, we can't publish that badge. Also need a signed testimonial release for the quote.
Priya (Partnerships): They attached a screenshot of the NVIDIA badge but not the approval doc. I'll request the badge permission and the signed release now.
Tom (Design): Drafted thumbnails. Two variants: 1200x1200 @1 and 1200x628 hero. Code snippet for export settings: ```
export settings: format: PNG, color profile: sRGB, resolution: 72dpi, safe-margin: 90px
```
Tom (Design): Uploaded drafts to folder: https://drive.redwood/latticegrid/designs. Also added source SVGs and a PSD with layers for mask and badge placements.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: marketplace listing validation rule update 2025-02: "Square thumbnail must contain no more than two partner logos; text must be readable at 400px."
Evan (Growth): For the short quote, they proposed: "Redwood + LatticeGrid cut inference costs 3x and halved latency." Need to confirm if they want exact metrics in the marketplace. If it's a case stat we need a data source or a less-specific phrasing.
Priya (Partnerships): Asked LatticeGrid PM to confirm the metric source. Suggested backup quote: "Improved inference latency and cost efficiency with Redwood."
Nora - Legal: If they keep the metric, request the methodology and an authorized sign-off. If they can't provide, push for the safer generic quote. Also asked to confirm the partner legal name for attribution.
LatticeGrid PM (via Evan): "We can sign off on the metric - internal perf report Q4 2024. We'll send the signed release and the badge approval from NVIDIA by EOD." (copied into drive comments)
Evan (Growth): Great. Once we have signed release + badge approval, we can include NVIDIA badge on the assets. If not, we'll show a neutral "Supports NVIDIA" text-only mention instead.
Tom (Design): Note on lockups: LatticeGrid prefers their lockup on the left, Redwood on the right for horizontal banners. For square thumbnail they want stacked marks. I made both options. Also added alt text suggestions in the PSD metadata.
Tom (Design): Alt suggestion: "LatticeGrid and Redwood deliver low-latency LLM inference across dedicated and on-prem deployments."
Priya (Partnerships): Accessibility check: Evan, can you confirm alt is concise and includes the joint solution framing? We need it for the marketplace form.
Evan (Growth): Yes that's fine, maybe shorten to: "LatticeGrid + Redwood: low-latency LLM inference." I'll put that in the listing form.
Nora - Legal: Received a draft of the signed release in the drive comments but not yet the NVIDIA approval doc. I can clear the testimonial once they upload the signed pdf with an authorized signature. ETA: can turn around legal ok within 2 hours of receiving docs.
Priya (Partnerships): Timeline: partner wants listing live next Wed. Let's target asset lock by Monday EOD. Tom, finalize final exports by Monday noon. Nora, please flag if badge approval missing; we'll use the text fallback. Evan will prepare marketplace metadata and a short case blurb.
Tom (Design): Will finalize assets Monday AM and include alt text, 2x retina exports, and layered source.
Evan (Growth): I'll draft the listing copy and short case blurb and share for quick sign-off in this thread.
Priya (Partnerships): Thanks team. One more ask from partner: they want a solution-brief PDF link available on the listing. Tom/Evan please confirm size/thumbnail for the PDF hero image.
Tom (Design): Use the 1600x600 hero for the PDF banner and export a 600x400 preview. I'll add that to the uploads.
MarketplaceBot: Note: when partner badge included, marketplace requires a separate "third-party logos" consent checkbox during submission.
Priya (Partnerships): Looping back once I have the signed release + badge doc. If anything stalls, we'll publish without the NVIDIA badge and update later. Thanks all :rocket:
